claim: The SCORE routine takes D = A:B, A an exponent (0-7) and B a BCD mantissa (0-99), and awards B x 10^A.
Killing a Lander (LKILL) awards KILP 0115 = 15 x 10^1 = 150 points.
Killing a Mutant (SCZKIL, the schizoid) awards KILP 0115 = 15 x 10^1 = 150 points.
Killing a Baiter (UFOKIL) awards KILP 0120 = 20 x 10^1 = 200 points.
Killing a Bomber (TIEKIL) awards KILO 0125 = 25 x 10^1 = 250 points.
Killing a Pod (PRBKIL, the probe) awards KILO 0210 = 10 x 10^2 = 1000 points.
Killing a Swarmer loads LDD #$0115 = 15 x 10^1 = 150 points before JSR SCORE.
Shooting a bomb/mine (BKIL) loads LDD #$25 = 25 x 10^0 = 25 points.
Catching a falling humanoid mid-air (P250) loads LDD #$0125 = 25 x 10^1 = 250 points.
Returning a caught humanoid to the ground (P500) loads LDD #$0150 = 50 x 10^1 = 500 points.
The wave-complete bonus multiplier is the wave number (PWAV), capped at 5 and shifted left four (x16) to a BCD tens digit with A=$01, i.e. min(wave,5) x 100 per surviving human.
The factory default REPLAY (extra man) level is $01,$00 = one extra man every 10,000 points.
The factory default number of ships (men) is NSHIP = $03 = 3.
A pop-up/score process runs as STYPE = 0, the SYSTEM PROCESS type.
